"John Bird's approach to mathematics, based on numerous worked examples and interactive problems, is ideal for students of a wide range of abilities. Theory is kept to a minimum, with the emphasis firmly placed on problem-solving skills, making this a thoroughly practical introduction to the mathematics that students need to master.
The extensive and thorough topic coverage makes this an ideal text for a range of level 2 and 3 vocational courses including the BTEC National specifications. Now in its seventh edition, Engineering Mathematics has helped thousands of students to succeed in their exams.
